picks.name: Scuba
picks.bio: Paul Rose, Hotflush's own founder. "Petrology" (April 10, 2026) is a six-track, vinyl-only Record Store Day EP -- Homing Device, Puppets, Petrology on side A, three Tío versions on side B -- covering the widest stylistic range of his productions since his 2015 album "Claustrophobia."
picks.why_listen: A producer revisiting the full width of his own language -- techno, rave energy, dub depth and ambient drift in one release, with enough atmosphere to keep it from feeling purely functional.

picks.name: Answer Code Request
picks.bio: Berlin producer marking his first album in eight years. "Halo" (June 26, 2026) applies the solid structures of floor-focused Berlin techno to the expressive space of introspective electronica.
picks.why_listen: A genuine comeback record -- functional enough for the floor but with more emotional range than straight club techno, good for a set's more introspective stretch.
